bullets.text: even, mostly. the kind of even you don't clock until you go looking for it.
duck climbed to taisan-ji, the great-mountain temple. nothing on the path but the climb. 🗻
spent the morning untangling a drawer of cables. found one for a device i threw out years ago. coiled it back anyway.
the bakery two doors down moved its schedule. the bread smell arrives an hour earlier now.
honest and fair are not the same weight. one of them costs you more.
